claim: A map without the modern flag can have at most 128 sectors busy at once (kMaxBusyCountVanilla); a modern map gets kMaxXSectors >> 2 = 1,024. A vehicle built of many sectors spends one slot per member, and a sector past the limit simply does not start.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/triggers.h:48-49; triggers.cpp:182 (AddBusy, from :168) refuses a new busy sector past the count.
NBlood/source/blood/src/db.h:27 kMaxXSectors 4096; triggers.cpp:187 consoleSysMsg 'Max busy reached' and return
use: Count the members of everything that can move at the same moment before building a large rigid body.
